[[File:Bandor_harbor.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The deep sea mines in [[Bandor (city)|Bandor]] harbor]]

This '''offshore mine''' was run by the [[Offworld Mining Corporation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bandomeer/Legends|Bandomeer]]. The mines were set up on floating rigs in the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], and their primary function was to look for [[Ionite]] under the ocean floor. The crew of the [[Mining/Legends|mine]] largely consisted of [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] of many [[Species/Legends|species]] which were guarded by [[Imbat]]s. In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], the abducted [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was brought to the mine. However, he was able to escape with the help of the [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] miner [[Guerra Derida]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. After the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had deactivated the locking devices which kept the slaves under the control, the revolted successfully.
